correctness.rationale: Each K2n spanning tree has one degree-two column and exactly one selected edge elsewhere, yielding W=sum_j sj tj product_{i != j}(si+ti). For disagreement count >=2 the multiplier vanishes; count one gives magnitude 2^(n-1), and count zero gives 2^(n-1)|sum si|. Thus the support is the radius-one disagreement mask minus a balanced binomial shell when n is even. The full mask Fourier kernel is 2^n 1_(u=v)(n+1-2|v|). The deleted shell Krawtchouk generating identity yields binom(n,2j)|B_2j|=binom(n,n/2)binom(n/2,j), and diagonal sign is unchanged by subtracting C because n+1-2|v| is odd and C<2^n. Summing absolute values proves the exact endpoint formulas and Stirling limits. Independent direct Walsh summations for n=2..8 gave norms 7/4,3/2,183/64,15/8,1095/256,35/16,106295/16384, matching formulas; finite checks do not establish all n.
